Method of Attack: Automated system to break Google's reCAPTCHA audio challenges by downloading audio puzzles, feeding them to multiple text-to-speech (TTS) systems, aggregating results, and submitting the most probable answer back to Google's servers
Discoverer: Team of four computer science experts from the University of Maryland (UM)
Attack Vector: Audio version of Google's reCAPTCHA challenges
Indicators of Compromise: Use of TTS systems such as Bing Speech Recognition, IBM, Google Cloud, Google Speech Recognition, Sphinx, and Wit-AI
Research paper titled 'unCaptcha: A Low-resource Defeat of reCaptcha's Audio Challenge' presented at Usenix Workshop on Offensive Technologies (WOOT) 2017
